_about: Scientific data library, domain anatomy: the universal columns of the game's body/data/anatomy.json tables, written by scripts/split_data.py. Same columns/rows schema as the game's tables. `id` is stable (see README); `source` holds source keys from sources.json ('; ' separated) or 'open'. Mark is the review state of these columns. A null in a column the engine's data/*.json holds by the same id means the engine file is the home of that value.

organs.title: The organs: what each does, needs, gives, and what fails when it fails
organs.source: Standard physiology (Guyton and Hall; Boron and Boulpaep) folded to one function capacity per organ (ANA-ORG). Each organ carries function (0 to 1 today) and damage (0 to 1, lasting; sets the maximum function), per the damage-vs-function rule. Period diseases from MEDICINE.md. Dependencies name the organ whose output is this one's input, so a failure propagates by the cascade column (ChatGPT's requirement 1, outside AI).

damage_function.title: Damage versus function (ChatGPT's distinction, kept as the rule)
damage_function.source: An organ can work badly today without lasting harm (a hangover's liver, a dehydrated kidney, a concussed brain), and chronic damage lowers the ceiling for good (cirrhosis, a scarred heart, lost nephrons). Two numbers per organ and tissue: function (today, 0 to 1) and damage (lasting, 0 to 1), with function never above (1 - damage).
rows: function_today = min(1 - damage, f(inputs today)); damage only rises, except by slow repair where the tissue regenerates (liver yes, heart muscle no, nerves barely, kidney nephrons no)
the drinker's liver works at 0.6 the morning after and 1.0 by evening until the damage sets the ceiling at 0.5
each organ's function today is the minimum of its input adequacies (perfusion, oxygen, fuel, electrolytes in range, temperature, toxins under threshold) x its own health
a kidney at full health with perfusion at 0.4 works at 0.4

damage += insult x (1 - resistance), where insults are sustained low function (ischaemia: function under 0.3 for over an hour damages the heart, brain and kidneys), toxins over threshold for days (alcohol, lead, mercury), infection, trauma
a shock that lasts hours leaves kidney damage even after the volume is back
damage -= repair rate while the insult is absent and NUTRITION's protein and energy allow: liver 0.01 a day, skin and gut lining 0.05, bone 0.005, heart and nerves 0, kidney 0.001
months without rum give the liver some ceiling back; a scarred heart never

a condition is a pattern of function and damage (heart failure: heart function under 0.5 for days; cirrhosis: liver damage over 0.5); MEDICINE.md keeps the names, the courses and the treatments; ANATOMY and CIRCULATION keep the numbers
the dropsy is the name for the pattern, not a separate rule
BODY.md reads organ function through CIRCULATION's deliveries (oxygen, fuel) and the brain's and senses' function; never an organ penalty of its own
one pathway per impairment, as before

respiratory.title: The respiratory profile (the lungs' interface to the air; per species)
respiratory.source: Gas transfer across the lung follows the partial-pressure gradient and the lung's diffusing capacity (Fick); ventilation, perfusion and diffusion each limit it (standard respiratory physiology, ATM-ALV). The profile fields are ChatGPT's list (outside AI), typed; the transfer formula is the model abstraction the brief names, not the full pulmonary equation.
rows: the species profile (ANATOMY 5); under water a human has none
lung function x chest wall intact (MEDICINE chest wounds) x age
mL O2 per min per mmHg gradient
lung damage (pneumonia, smoke injury, consumption), fluid in the lungs (heart failure), age
irritant gases (SO2, smoke) raise it: x2 to x5 during exposure; asthma (none modelled)
smoke and irritant injury (MEDICINE), infection, drowning
Species susceptibility data only; medicine computes the effect. A diving mammal tolerates more CO2; open.
transfer = exchange capacity x (inspired-alveolar gradient after the alveolar gas equation); arterial PO2 follows alveolar PO2 less a 5 to 10 mmHg gradient in health, more with damage
not enough oxygen in the air (ATMOSPHERE: low fraction or low pressure) vs the lung failing to transfer it (damage, fluid, resistance): same saturation, different cure
